preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= n <= 10000 for n in test_case_ns)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is an integer between 1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(val, int) and 1 <= val <= 100000 for val in arr) for arr in test_case_arrays)
preconditions.description: Each array element is a positive integer between 1 and 10^5.
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 10^4.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(k, int) and 0 <= k <= 3 * n for k, n in zip(output_k_list, test_case_ns))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the number of operations k is an integer between 0 and 3n.

postconditions.expression: all(len(ops) == k for k, ops in zip(output_k_list, output_ops_list))
postconditions.description: The number of operation lines printed matches the declared k for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= n and 0 <= x <= 10**9 for i, j, x in ops) for ops, n in zip(output_ops_list, test_case_ns))
postconditions.description: Each operation (i, j, x) satisfies 1 <= i, j <= n and 0 <= x <= 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(all(val >= 0 for val in simulate_ops(arr, ops)) for arr, ops in zip(test_case_arrays, output_ops_list))
postconditions.description: After every operation in the sequence, all array elements remain non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(all(val == final_val for val in simulate_ops(arr, ops)) for arr, ops in zip(test_case_arrays, output_ops_list) for final_val in [simulate_ops(arr, ops)[0]])
postconditions.description: After the sequence of operations, all elements in the array are equal.

postconditions.expression: all(k == -1 or (k != -1 and all(val == final_val for val in simulate_ops(arr, ops))) for k, arr, ops in zip(output_k_list, test_case_arrays, output_ops_list) for final_val in [simulate_ops(arr, ops)[0] if k != -1 else []])
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the output provides a valid sequence; otherwise, -1 is printed.
